title: Water Restored — North Area — Jun 12
_full_body: If you would like to respond to this notification, please place your response above the dotted line. An update was distributed yesterday at approximately 6:10 PM notifying residents that potable water service to the north section has been fully restored. It has been brought to our attention that this communication did not reach all residents as intended. We sincerely apologize for this oversight and any confusion it may have caused. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
